method: Same-agent English/Marathi close reading and reverse paraphrase of all changed explanatory, example, caption and exercise blocks; exact diagram, formula, macro, label and reference parity, with one documented prose-state projection. No independent human or native-speaker review is claimed.
scope: State-diagram representation, even-machine transition traces, machine tables, a stroke-doubling strategy and five exercises.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A state diagram has state nodes connected by instruction arrows. The two-state first machine maps (q0, blank) to (q1, stroke, right). The even machine alternates q0 and q1 while reading strokes, loops right on blank only in q1, and halts exactly for even stroke counts under the input-shape assumption.
samples.checks: The first diagram, all three even-machine transition equations, the iff condition and the all-strokes-before-first-blank assumption are retained verbatim as mathematics.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: Configurations show tape contents, state and head location. Four strokes advance through q0, q1, q0, q1 to q0 on blank and halt; three strokes reach q1 on blank, then move right forever across blanks. Adding the missing q0-on-blank loop makes the even machine never halt.
samples.checks: Every displayed configuration, subscript, transition tuple and even/odd acceptance behavior is unchanged. OLTUR-001 corrects the frozen prose 'state one' to q0, matching the first display and applicable transition.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: A machine table places tape symbols on the x axis and states on the y axis, with missing entries marking potential halts. The doubler consumes an n-stroke block and outputs a 2n-stroke block by erasing one input stroke at a time and writing two output strokes, leaving one blank separator; the diagram is unchanged.
samples.checks: Both axes, all table cells, the q0-on-blank halt, the n-to-2n relation, the separator and no-missed-or-double-counted input invariant are retained.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: The exercises request a trace of the doubler, a halting recognizer for equal numbers of A and B with all A before B, string duplication alpha to alpha-alpha, an order checker that leaves input and loops on failure, and a reorderer placing all A before all B.
samples.checks: Each exercise's halting versus nonhalting requirement, output preservation or reordering requirement, alphabet, references and all positive and negative example strings are intact.

source_observations: OLTUR-001: the frozen sentence says 'state one' immediately after a q0 initial configuration; Marathi follows the configuration and q0 transition. The source bytes are untouched and the QA projection is limited to that occurrence.

T339 records state diagram, configuration, machine table and doubler as source-defined Marathi compounds. The legal and metallurgical official glosses for configuration were not imported into the Turing sense.
limitations: No independent human or native-speaker review has been performed.
